prompt:
Create a production-ready 2D character animation sprite sheet for an original fantasy arena game, not a poster or concept art. One character only: the Balanced Wizard, a compact charming adult wizard with a hidden face and two small warm eyes under a floppy broad pointed hat, sapphire royal-blue cloth robe, ivory short beard, dark leather boots, small gold belt clasp, amber/gold runic hat trim, and a wooden staff with a round amber crystal. The royal-blue cloth robe and hat fabric are the team's recolorable area; keep them clearly saturated blue (#2866ba), distinct from neutral leather and amber accents. Original stylized hand-painted game art with broad readable silhouettes, clean dark outlines, restrained cel shading, high contrast at small size. Use an elevated 3/4 game camera approximately 50 degrees above the ground, consistent lighting from upper left. Crisp whole-body sprites, no terrain, no ground shadow, no floor, no base, no UI, no text, no labels, no tile grid lines.
The output is ONE square RGBA transparent PNG sprite atlas, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells, ideally 1024 x 1024 total (256px per cell). Sixteen equally sized full-body sprites. IMPORTANT: absolutely transparent empty space between sprites and outside them, not an opaque background, no checkerboard painted into the image. Each full character including staff and hat stays entirely inside its own cell with generous padding. All sixteen characters use the SAME size, proportions, clothes, staff and foot baseline; each is centered horizontally on the middle of its cell, soles at 88 percent down the cell, highest hat at 13 percent down.
Read the atlas from left to right:
Column 1: relaxed idle pose with staff held upright.
Column 2: walking contact pose A, one foot forward and slight arm swing.
Column 3: walking contact pose B, opposite foot forward and opposite arm swing.
Column 4: spell-casting pose, staff and free hand lifted forward, with a SMALL amber rune glow near the staff head contained within the cell.
Read the atlas from top to bottom:
Row 1: facing SOUTH, toward viewer, front view from above.
Row 2: facing WEST, screen left, left profile from above.
Row 3: facing NORTH, away from viewer, back view from above.
Row 4: facing EAST, screen right, right profile from above.
Follow this exact 4x4 grid and pose order, do not add a title, do not add extra characters. It must look like polished usable game animation frames, with consistent silhouette size and alignment.

Create the PYROMANCER variant of the referenced 4-by-4 wizard animation sprite atlas for the same game. Preserve the exact same 4 columns and 4 rows layout, transparent background, cell size, character scale, foot baseline, camera angle, stylized hand-painted rendering, clean outlines, and directions. This is production sprite artwork, never a poster. Make a distinct fire specialist: short stout wizard, a taller kinked flame-orange pointed hat with charcoal rim and ember-red fire runes, short copper-red beard, dark face with amber eyes, burnt leather shoulders and belt, red-orange cloth collar and flame-shaped gold/orange robe hem details, staff topped with a faceted glowing orange FIRE crystal. The large main robe cloth must stay saturated sapphire royal-blue (#2866ba) so the engine can replace its color for the team; do NOT turn the robe itself orange. The hat and elemental details are orange, separate from the blue robe. Keep outlines crisp and broad silhouettes readable at small size, no dense noise or excessive sparks.
Rows must remain: row 1 facing SOUTH/front toward viewer; row 2 WEST/screen left; row 3 NORTH/back away; row 4 EAST/screen right.
Columns must remain: column 1 idle, column 2 walk step A, column 3 walk step B with opposite foot forward, column 4 casting with lifted staff/free hand and a SMALL fire rune glow contained in its cell.
IMPORTANT CORRECTION: the wooden staff must remain clearly held by the wizard in ALL SIXTEEN frames, including every sprite in column 3. Never omit the staff in a walk frame.
All sprites wholly contained in equally sized cells, ample transparent padding, same soles baseline at 88 percent of each cell. No overlap between cells, no outlines of grid, no words, no labels, no ground or shadow. Return ONE square 4x4 RGBA atlas with a truly transparent background.

Create the CRYOMANCER variant of this wizard sprite atlas. Use the reference for the same original hand-painted fantasy game art style, character scale, camera, exact 4x4 grid layout, foot alignment, and pose/direction order, but give the ice specialist a clearly different silhouette. He has a tall angular pale-white ice hood/hat with a broad frost-blue rim and two small crystalline points, silver-white beard, dark face with two icy cyan eyes, frosted white shoulder mantles, silver belt clasp and snowflake hem trim. Long wooden staff with a pointed translucent pale cyan ice crystal. The MAIN TUNIC stays saturated sapphire royal-blue (#2866ba) for engine team recoloring; all ice accents and hat are WHITE and pale cyan (low saturation, never saturated blue). Keep broad simple details readable at 70px character height.
ONE square transparent RGBA atlas, exactly 4 columns by 4 rows, no grid lines, titles or labels.
Rows 1 to 4: SOUTH front toward viewer; WEST facing left; NORTH back away; EAST facing right. Same elevated 3/4 camera at 50 degrees, from above.
Columns 1 to 4: idle holding staff; walk A left foot forward holding staff; walk B right foot forward HOLDING THE STAFF visibly at the same side of the body (do not omit it); casting with staff and free hand lifted and a SMALL pale-cyan snowflake rune glow contained in the tile.
The robe, boots, beard, staff and hat must stay consistent across all frames. Preserve the staff in EVERY column including column 3. Entire full body in each cell, soles at 88 percent down each cell, hat at about 10 percent, generous transparent space around each sprite. Truly empty transparent background, no shadows, no scenery, no ground, no checkerboard. All silhouettes separate and contained in their own cells.

Create the STORMCALLER (lightning wizard) variant of this reference game animation atlas. Exactly the same original stylized hand-painted fantasy sprite style, compact adult wizard body, 50-degree elevated 3/4 camera, 4 columns and 4 rows of equal cells, true transparent background, pose order and character scale. Give him a distinct slender jagged VIOLET pointed hat with two swept-back lightning-shaped tips, lilac glowing eyes inside a dark face, short silvery-lilac beard, violet lightning rune band, dark charcoal shoulder cape, silver buckle and violet zigzag hem details. Wooden staff topped with a slim VIOLET lightning crystal, with a restrained lavender electric glow on casting frames only. The large central TUNIC remains SATURATED SAPPHIRE ROYAL BLUE (#2866ba) for team recoloring; do not make the tunic violet. The hat, crystal, runes and small trims must be visibly VIOLET (#ad68ed), not blue or cyan.
Rows 1 to 4: SOUTH/front facing viewer, WEST/facing screen left, NORTH/back away, EAST/facing screen right.
Columns 1 to 4: standing idle holding staff, walking step A holding staff, walking step B with opposite foot and ALWAYS holding the same staff, casting lifting staff and free hand with a SMALL electric rune glow within its tile.
In all walking frames the staff remains in the SAME hand and visible on the outside of the body. Entire body, staff and hat contained in each cell with ample padding. Same soles baseline near 88 percent of each tile. No scenery, shadows, background, text or grid. Sixteen clean separated full-body sprites in ONE RGBA 4x4 atlas.

Create the GEOMANCER (earth wizard) variant of this reference sprite sheet for an original fantasy PvP game. Exact same coherent hand-painted game sprite style, camera from above at 50 degrees, compact adult wizard scale, 4 columns by 4 rows transparent atlas, foot baseline, directions and pose order. This earth wizard is broader and sturdier: a low chunky bent pointed ochre-brown hat with a thick sandstone rim and polygonal stone plates, dark face with warm golden eyes, thick sandy-brown beard, carved stone shoulder pauldrons, large bronze belt clasp, angular ochre geometric rune trim on the hem. Wooden staff topped with a large ochre sandstone CUBE crystal. The main robe cloth must stay SATURATED SAPPHIRE ROYAL BLUE (#2866ba) for team color replacement; the hat and armor details are warm ochre, sandstone tan and bronze. Strong clear silhouette distinct from the orange fire hat, white ice hat and purple storm hat.
Rows top to bottom: SOUTH toward viewer/front; WEST screen left; NORTH away/back; EAST screen right. Columns left to right: idle with staff; walk step A with staff; walk step B with opposite foot forward and the same staff ALWAYS visible; casting with lifted staff and small golden-brown geometric rune glow. Keep same staff in same hand in all 16 frames.
ONE square RGBA transparent 4x4 atlas. Entire full body and hat/staff fit within every equal-sized cell with ample padding, no overlap, soles at 88 percent down each tile. Crisp outlines and broad shading, detailed enough to look polished but readable when scaled to 70px. No grid lines, text, labels, shadow, ground, scenery or opaque background.
